content.title: THE REAL REASON YOU FEEL {{OFF}} ALL THE TIME (AND IT'S NOT STRESS)
facts: **Magnesium** – Muscle cramps, anxiety, trouble falling asleep, and a heartbeat that feels irregular or skips.
**Vitamin A** – Trouble seeing at night, dry gritty eyes, frequent colds, and rough patchy skin.
**Folate** – Mouth ulcers, unusual paleness, irritability, and getting winded from simple tasks.
**Vitamin E** – Muscle weakness, blurry or worsening vision, tingling hands, and slower recovery from illness.
**Omega-3** – Dry flaky skin, stiff aching joints, low mood, and trouble focusing on tasks.
**Vitamin D** – Deep bone aches, constant tiredness, catching every cold going around, and thinning hair.
**Iron** – Pale skin, brittle nails, cold hands and feet, and exhaustion that sleep doesn't fix.
**Calcium** – Muscle spasms, brittle nails, tooth problems, and numbness or tingling in your fingers.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
A few of these deserve extra attention. Magnesium is involved in hundreds of enzyme reactions in your body, and it plays a big role in calming your nervous system — when levels drop, your heart's electrical signals can misfire, which is why palpitations and anxiety often show up together. Folate is essential for making new red blood cells and repairing DNA; without enough, your body starts producing oversized, abnormal red blood cells, leading to that draining fatigue and those stubborn mouth sores. Vitamin E acts as an antioxidant that protects your nerve membranes from damage, so when it's low, nerve signals can misfire, causing tingling, numbness, and balance issues. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours.
